target.purpose: Initial Sonic movement parity telemetry. Prefer source-backed offsets and guest PCs; unresolved fields are explicitly marked discovery_required.

capture_strategy.primary: Add read-only telemetry hooks in UnleashedRecomp at stable guest update/posture PCs. Resolve the active Sonic CCharacterProxy pointer once per sampled player update, then snapshot guest memory through g_memory.Translate without mutating guest state.
capture_strategy.cadence: Capture one coherent sample per Sonic simulation update. Preserve guest dt as a field; do not assume host-present cadence equals simulation cadence. 30 Hz is the original-behaviour reference repeatedly used by UnleashedRecomp fixes, while some HFR paths run at 60 Hz or above.
capture_strategy.ordering: For parity traces, sample position/velocity and derived values at the same hook phase each frame. Record guest PC, frame index, and dt with every row so traces from original/recompiled implementations can be aligned.
capture_strategy.discovery: For signals marked discovery_required, instrument the named guest PC/function region and log candidate registers plus nearby object memory across controlled scenarios (idle, run, jump/fall, wall/slope, boost, enter/leave 2D, animation transitions). Promote a candidate to a fixed offset only after correlation and write-site confirmation.
capture_strategy.recommended_output: JSONL or CSV rows keyed by frame_index and guest_pc; keep raw vectors/components in guest units and add derived scalar metrics separately.

evidence.fact: CCharacterProxy has 0x120 bytes of padding, then CVector m_Position and CVector m_Velocity.
CVector is four big-endian float32 components X/Y/Z/W, therefore 16 bytes.
Named Sonic speed posture hook sites identify 3D, 2D/on-path/force-path, and path-local execution regions at 0x8234EEE8, 0x8234F194, and 0x8234F610.
0x8231F824 is shared by CPlayerSpeedStateNormalDamageStandUp / CSonicStateStartEvent / CSonicStateStompingLand.

UnleashedRecomp treats time deltas as seconds and repeatedly uses 1/30 s as original-behaviour reference. The 2D spline HFR sites at 0x82345468, 0x8234547C, 0x823454B0, 0x82345534, 0x823455EC, 0x8234564C, 0x823457A8, and 0x823458A0 expose dt in f1.
2D camera HFR hooks label 0x824761AC as Player velocity and 0x824762AC as Player position; both use f0/f28 and are useful independent correlation probes.

Debug/source strings identify PlayerSpeedContext.cpp, PlayerSpeedStateBase.cpp, PathController.cpp, PlayerSpeedPosturePluginAutoMoveOnPath.cpp, and runtime parameter strings including Gravity and Boost.
